subject: Pharmacokinetics and Biopharmaceutics
topic: One-Compartment Intravenous Pharmacokinetics: Clearance and Half-Life
syllabus_context: Module 2: Basic Pharmacokinetics. Physiological compartments, intravenous bolus administration, first-order elimination rate constant (k_e), apparent volume of distribution (V_d), systemic clearance (CL), elimination half-life (t_1/2), relationship CL = k_e * V_d, and non-linear (capacity-limited) elimination kinetics.
declared_learning_objective: Formulate the one-compartment intravenous bolus pharmacokinetic model, derive the plasma concentration decay equation C(t) = C_0 * e^(-k_e * t), calculate volume of distribution and total clearance, solve multi-step dosage half-life calculations, and evaluate non-linear Michaelis-Menten elimination saturation in clinical overdoses.

provenance.source: Standard University Medical School Pharmacology Lecture Series

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Plasma drug concentration-time semi-logarithmic decay curves and clinical dose equations projected on screen.
